hooks.command: /bin/sh -c 'f="$HOME/bin/ctxtra"; if [ -x "$f" ]; then exec "$f" hook codex SessionStart; else /bin/cat >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"ctxtra: the ctxtra binary that this hook runs is missing; reinstall ctxtra, or run ctxtra setup --agent codex with the new binary (Codex will then ask you to trust the hooks again)\"}"; fi'
/bin/sh -c 'f="$HOME/bin/ctxtra"; if [ -x "$f" ]; then exec "$f" hook codex SubagentStart; else /bin/cat >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "{}"; fi'
